project_name: Marco Polo Wentylacja - Business Card Welcome Page
target_audience: Piggery farm owners, ventilation operators, PLC technicians, and farm managers in Poland using Fatek PLC / MQTT system

design_philosophy.theme: Dark Moody Industrial IoT with Emerald Green Accent
core_principles: Tactical Industrial Aesthetic: High contrast telemetry look with dark matte surfaces (#0A0A0A) and glowing status indicators (#34A56A).
Immediate Action: Focus on zero-friction access to the live ventilation control system via 'Zaloguj' CTA and tenant link auto-routing.
Data Trust & Precision: Feature real-time simulated telemetry metrics (temperature, humidity, CO2, curtain status, fan speeds) to build immediate confidence.
Mobile-First & PWA First: Perfectly optimized for 390px mobile screens (one-handed thumb control) scaling elegantly to 1920px widescreen dashboard displays.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold uppercase tracking-tight font-head
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold uppercase tracking-wide font-head
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-mono tracking-wider uppercase text-muted

layout_and_structure.viewport_behavior: Strict 100vh viewport fitting on desktop without accidental vertical overflow, responsive single scroll container on mobile (390px).
layout_and_structure.grid_system: 12-column Swiss grid on desktop (lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8), single column on mobile (grid-cols-1 gap-4).

elements: Brand identity with logo icon, title 'Marco Polo Wentylacja', and status badge 'Fatek PLC / MQTT System Active'
Tagline: 'Precyzyjna kontrola temperatury, wilgotności, CO₂ oraz klap i kominów wentylacyjnych w Twoich komorach.'
Primary CTA: 'ZALOGUJ SIĘ DO SYSTEMU' (opens login modal or redirects to auth screen) with green neon subtle glow
Language switch (PL / EN) in top-right floating header glass panel
Client link handling: ?klient=... parameter automatically bypasses landing and forwards to direct login screen if present.
Interactive / Animated Telemetry Preview Card ('Kolekcja Komór Live')
Live sensor pills showing simulated real-time stats (Temp: 21.4°C, Wilgotność: 62%, CO₂: 780 ppm, Klapy: 45% Uchylone, Komin: RUNNING)
Hero Image overlay with dark moody industrial farm fan or piggery interior (dark overlay with gradient transition to #141414)
System state badges: Broker MQTT Online, Sterownik Fatek Active, Alarm System Ready

contact_block.visibility_rule: Hidden by default if empty. Displayed at bottom of card if phone/email filled in Settings or props.

hero_images.description: Industrial barn ventilation fan with metal housing - ideal dark moody backdrop
Clean modern piggery facility interior showing chamber pens

motion_and_interactions.login_button_hover: Hover state escalates shadow to box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(52,165,106,0.4) and subtle translateY(-2px)
motion_and_interactions.telemetry_pulses: Green LED indicators pulse gently with 1.8s ease-in-out infinite animation
motion_and_interactions.curtain_animation: Simulated vent curtain position bar animates smoothly on slider hover or state cycle
motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: Respects prefers-reduced-motion media query by disabling pulse and slide effects

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all code remains compatible with React JS (.js extension, no TSX syntax).
Keep styling in line with CSS variables already declared in /app/frontend/src/index.css (--bg, --card, --border, --primary, --text).
Verify that the 'Zaloguj' button triggers the existing authentication flow seamlessly.
Do NOT force a light theme; default to dark theme (#0A0A0A) matching the app shell.
Include all specified data-testids on interactive elements to satisfy test suites.
